name: Residents experiencing homelessness
source: Monterey County 2024 Homelessness Point-In-Time Count, Applied Survey Research; denominator: California DOF population estimate reproduced in the County's 2025–26 Legislative Platform
notes: The opened PIT report identifies 2,436 people experiencing homelessness in Monterey County on January 31, 2024 (report page 12). The opened County 2025–26 Legislative Platform states that California DOF estimated Monterey County population at 437,614 in 2024 (PDF page 6): https://www.countyofmonterey.gov/home/showpublisheddocument/138247/638736919326900000. Calculation: 2,436 ÷ 437,614 × 10,000 = 55.7. The PIT study is produced by Applied Survey Research for the local Continuum of Care. Retried capture for the PIT PDF timed out; County platform capture returned HTTP 403 after browser fallback. Neither source was archived, so snapshot_path is empty.
